day_local: Jimcaha Toddobaadka Soddonka ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Ilaaha Aabbeheenna ah iyo Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Sayidow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Sayidow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Sidee u waaweyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga!
homily:
Bal ka fikir sawirka qof taagan oo gacantiisa ku haya qalab casri ah, laga yaabee inuu yahay qayb ka mid ah diyaarad uu si taxaddar leh u dhisayo, ama uu ku dhex jiro koodhka barnaamij kombuyuutar oo uu maskaxdiisa ku nashqadeeyey. Waa sawirka qof u dhow oo dunida u eegaya indho wax dhisaya oo la yaab leh. Waxaan maanta rabaa inaan maskaxda ku hayno hal sawir oo fudud: waa gacanta oo si furan u taagan si ay u bixiso caawimaad. Ma aha gacantii wax ururinaysay, ee waa gacantii bixinaysay. Waa gacantii Benjamin Vo, wiilkaas qaaliga ah ee mar walba naxariista iyo jacaylka ka horreysiin jiray wax kasta oo kale.

Akhriska maanta ee Bawlos uu u qoray reer Filiboy wuxuu inoo sheegayaa wax aad u qurux badan. Wuxuu leeyahay: 'Ilaaha bilaabay shuqul wanaagsan oo idinku jira, wuu sii dhammaystiri doonaa ilaa maalinta Ciise Masiix.' Bawlos wuxuu ka hadlayaa wada-shaqaynta nimcada. Wuxuu xusuusanayaa dadka uu jecel yahay, wuxuuna u ducaynayaa in jacaylkoodu uu koro. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil noloshaas jacaylka ah ku noolaa. Waxaan ognahay inuu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay aad u fiiqnayd, oo jeclaa tiknoolajiyadda iyo inuu wax abuuro, gaar ahaan riyadiisii 'con chim airlines'—shirkaddaas diyaaradeed ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray. Laakiin waxa ka sii weynaa maskaxdiisa fiiqan wuxuu ahaa qalbigiisii jilicsanaa oo had iyo jeer u furnaa dadka kale.

Waxaan rabaa inaan si gaar ah u xusuusanno daqiiqad yar oo ka mid ah nolosha Ben. Waxay ahayd markii uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabayo inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa sanduuqa ku jirta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa hibo aan la soo koobi karin. Taasi waa dabeecadda wiilka qalbiga wanaagsan. Wuxuu ahaa wiil fahmay in nolosha ay macno samaynayso kaliya markaan wax bixinno.

Laakiin, aan marka hore runta si daacad ah u wajahno intaanan halkaas sii marin. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus oo aan la qiyaasi karin. Waxaa jira subaxyo marka aad kacdaan oo aad dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid qabow, oo ay adag tahay in la neefsado. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad dib u eegtaan wax walba oo dhacay, idinkoo is weydiinaya haddii aad wax ka bedeli karseen. Fadlan, halkan istaaga oo dhageysta tan: xanuunkan iyo dhibaatadan midkoodna ma aha khaladkiinna. Sida Ciise uu mar u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunkan iyo cudurkan midkoodna ma aha wax idinka yimid; ma jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna wuxuu ahaa mid dhab ah oo aan xad lahayn. Ha is-eedeynin, hana qaadin culeys uusan Ilaah idin saarin.

Oo halkaas, bartamaha mugdiga iyo xanuunka, waxaa soo galaya Injiilka maanta oo noo sheegaya jawaabta Ciise uu u celiyay Farisiiyiinta. Ciise wuxuu arkay nin xanuunsan, wuxuuna weydiiyey: 'Is it lawful to cure on the sabbath or not?' Farisiiyiintii way aamuseen, laakiin Ciise wuu bogsiiyay ninkii. Wuxuu kaloo weydiiyey: 'Who among you, if your son or ox falls into a cistern, would not immediately pull him out on the sabbath day?' Ciise wuxuu na barayaa in naxariista iyo jacaylka ay ka sarreeyaan wax walba. Ciise ma eego shuruucda si uu dadka u xidho; wuxuu u eegaa si uu dadka u xoreeyo.

Benjamin, wiilkaas qaaliga ah, wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay gacmaha Ciise, meel uusan xanuun ka jirin. Sida uu ku yiri riyadii uu la wadaagay qoyskiisa, 'Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết. Con tự thở được bình thường mà…' Wuxuu gudbay imtixaankii nolosha si kaamil ah. Wuxuu hadda joogaa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo nabad qaba. Wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaanan ka cabsanin xanuunka, waayo jacaylka Ilaah ayaa ka weyn wax walba.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro wadnahaaga. Xusuuso riyooyinkii aad wadaagteen, iyo jacaylka aan dhimanayn ee idin mideeya. Ha ka baqina inaad horay u socoto, oo aad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee Ben uu mar walba ka helayay inuu arko. Ben wuxuu weli ku jecel yahay, wuxuuna kugu dhiirigelinayaa inaad noolaato nolol buuxda.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha, halkaas oo uu ka ilaalinayo qoyskiisa. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jeclahay wax walba oo ka sarreeya, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruuxa. Waxaan isku duubayaa naftayda adiga, ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto had iyo goor. Ilaah ha idinku barakeeyo jacaylkiisa aan dhammaadka lahayn.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nabad iyo iftiin weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah u soo dejiyo raaxo, xoog, iyo rajo ay ku sii wadaan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Bawlos iyo Timoteyos, oo ah addoommadii Ciise Masiix, waxaan u qoraynaa dhammaan quduusiinta ku jira Ciise Masiix ee jooga Filiboy, iyo kormeerayaasha iyo wadaaddada: Nimco iyo nabad ha idinla jiraan xagga Ilaaha Aabbeheenna ah iyo xagga Rabbiga Ciise Masiix. Waxaan Ilaahayga ugu mahadnaqayaa mar kasta oo aan idin soo xusuusto, anigoo mar walba ducadayda oo dhan idinku baryaya farxad, sababtoo ah wada-shaqayntiinna xagga Injiilka tan iyo maalintii ugu horraysay ilaa hadda. Waxaan ku kalsoonahay tan, in kii shuqul wanaagsan idinku bilaabay uu sii dhammaystiri doono ilaa maalinta Ciise Masiix. Waa sax inaan sidan uga fikiro dhammaantiin, waayo waxaan idinku hayaa qalbigayga, idinkoo dhammaantiin wada-hawlgalayaal ila ah xagga nimcada, xagga xadhigayga iyo xagga difaaca iyo xaqiijinta Injiilka. Waayo Ilaah baa markhaati ii ah, sida aan idiinku hiloobay jacaylka Ciise Masiix. Ducadayduna waa tan: in jacaylkiinnu uu koro mar walba xagga aqoonta iyo garashada nooc kasta, si aad u kala garataan waxa qiimaha leh, si aad u ahaataan kuwo saafi ah oo aan eed lahayn maalinta Masiixa, idinkoo ka buuxa midhaha xaqnimada ee ku yimaada Ciise Masiix, ammaanta iyo mahadnaqa Ilaah.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Sidee u waaweyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga! Waxaan Rabbiga ugu mahadnaqi doonaa qalbigayga oo dhan, shirka iyo kulanka kuwa xaqa ah. Waaweyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga, oo lagu raaxaysto dhammaan. R. Sidee u waaweyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga! Sharaf iyo ammaano ayaa shuqulkiisa ah, caddaaladdiisuna weligeed way sii jiraysaa. Wuxuu magac ku yeeshay shuqulladiisa cajaa'ibka ah; Rabbigu waa naxariis iyo raxmad badan yahay. R. Sidee u waaweyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga! Wuxuu cunto siiyey kuwa isaga ka cabsada; wuxuu weligiis xusuusan doonaa axdigiisa. Wuxuu dadkiisa u muujiyey awoodda shuqulladiisa, isagoo siiyey dhaxalka quruumaha. R. Sidee u waaweyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga!

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Maalin Sabti ah ayaa Ciise u tegey inuu wax ku cuno guriga mid ka mid ah Farisiiyiinta madaxda ah, dadkiina way u fiirsanayeen si taxaddar leh. Hortiisa waxaa joogay nin qaba cudurka bararka. Ciise ayaa u hadlay culimadii sharciga iyo Farisiiyiintii, isagoo weydiinaya, 'Miyaa sharcigu oggol yahay in la bogsiiyo maalinta Sabtida mise maya?' Laakiin way aamuseen; markaasuu ninkii qabtay, oo ka dib markuu bogsiiyay, wuu iska diray. Markaasuu ku yidhi iyagii, 'Yaa idinka mid ah, haddii wiilkiisa ama dibigigiisa uu ku dhaco ceel, aan isla markiiba soo saarayn maalinta Sabtida?' Laakiin way awoodi waayeen inay su'aashiisa ka jawaabaan.

day: Friday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
